task: T06/T10 of the SmartTube AI-subtitle plan: judge the cross-state semantics of the prefetch chain (single call gate, cancellation, retry budget, duplicate dispatch, snapshot cancellation safety) before the UI and integration work builds on it.

checks.claim: The dispatcher starts at most one call at a time, and a new call requires the previous one to report back plus at least one second since the previous start.
A cancelled attempt keeps the slot busy until it reports back, and its late result is dropped instead of being cached or applied.
The attempt budget is not reset by cache eviction, and once an item's budget is used up the item is marked done so no later tick resubmits it.
checks.evidence:
Cache: failure bookkeeping lives in mAttempts/mExhausted, separate from the LRU mEntries; evict() only touches mEntries.
Dispatcher handleFailure: for each item, if (!mCache.recordFailure(id)) { mPlanner.markDone(id); } then markFinished(batch, false).
Tests: failureBudgetIsNotResetByCacheEviction (1 -> true, insert 2100 entries, 2 -> false and hasExhausted true); retryableFailureIsPlannedAgainAndThenAbandoned (after the second failure the abandoned ids never reappear in a later batch).

checks.claim: An id that is queued, in flight or already done is never planned into another batch.
checks.evidence:
nextBatch skips an item when mPending.contains(id) || mDone.contains(id) || mOversize.contains(id).
Tests: queuedAndFinishedItemsAreNeverPlannedAgain (a queued batch's ids are absent from the next batch and a finished batch's ids cannot be replanned); successIsCachedAndItsItemsAreNotPlannedAgain at the dispatcher level.

checks.claim: The snapshot fetch honours cancellation before opening the payload and always releases what it opened; a cancelled fetch reports CANCELLED and never a timeline.
checks.evidence:
fetch(): checks cancelled before touching the factory, checks again after opening, passes '() -> cancelled.getAsBoolean()' to the reader, and closes the payload in finally.
Tests: aCancelledFetchDoesNotEvenOpenThePayload (the factory is never called and the status is CANCELLED); thePayloadIsAlwaysReleased (an instrumented stream records close even on success); aMissingSourceIsReportedAsNoSource; aFailingPayloadFactoryBecomesAnIoFailure.
